messages:
jo_marketing: planning a 45m micro-summit next Thurs (ptl: infra + product). need registration page copy, CTA variants, Zoom/RTMP routing, and post-event clip plan. can we capture company size + role? also want to A/B test CTAs that map to different nurture paths.

mike_ops: prefer one Zoom meeting with dual RTMP outputs (primary -> CDN, backup -> s3 ingest). cloud recording as archive. will disable Zoom auto-transcribe; we run our whisper pipeline. I'll provision OBS fallback VM.

anya_events: reg page ideas: CTAs: "watch a short demo" vs "book a custom benchmark". fields: company size (1-10,11-50,51-200,201-1000,1000+), role (Eng/Product/Infra/Exec), opt-in checkbox for use of recording, and a separate speaker consent checkbox for panelists. map CTA clicks to HubSpot lists.

leo_creative: post-event deliverables: full MP4 master + VTT, plus 3 clips per session: teaser (0-60s), deep snippet (60-300s), and full highlight (first 10 minutes). produce 16:9 masters and 1:1 social cuts. thumbnails: 3 variants. email cadence: immediate thanks + slides + private 48h access; 24h send teaser; 72h send deep snippet to engaged watchers (>25% watch); 7d nurture based on company size and engagement. HubSpot props to set: hs_event_code, c_company_size, c_role, c_opt_in_recording, watch_pct, clip_clicked.

mike_ops: Zoom checklist: enable cloud recording (record gallery + shared screen), live streaming to custom service enabled, rotate stream keys per event, schedule 30m tech rehearsal, RTMP key healthcheck 30m prior. ffmpeg capture we're using for ingestion: ```ffmpeg -i rtmp://ingest/key -c copy -f segment -segment_time 300 s3://events/microsummit/%Y%m%d-%03d.mp4```

anya_events: handoff: raw -> s3://events/{year}/{month}/{day}/microsummit/{session}/. metadata CSV row per file: event_id, session, speakers, meeting_id, stream_key_hash, start_ts, end_ts. transcription job triggers whisper-v2, then clips + vtt generation, upload to CDN and register asset URLs in HubSpot event record.

leo_creative: fallback assets: 90s branded loop ready on OBS VM; standby producer to trigger fallback and switch back when live. I'll upload thumbnails and caption style guide.

streambot: reminders scheduled: speaker nudge 24h and 1h prior; RTMP healthcheck 30m prior; ingest smoke test 20m prior.

jo_marketing: volunteers for tech run? propose Wed 9am. I'm drafting reg copy and UTM mapping (utm_campaign=microsummit_launch, utm_content=cta_variant). will post draft link in 30m: https://docs.redwood/events/microsummit/launch-assets
